headline: Li Auto rises 11% as its loss narrows sharply and it expects a return to profit this quarter
summary: Li Auto gained 11.0% to $11.88 after third-quarter revenue rose 5.4% to RMB28.8 billion, above its own guidance, the net loss shrank to RMB310 million from RMB1.7 billion in the second quarter, and the company said it expects to be profitable again in the fourth quarter.
why: Margins recovered strongly from a weak spring: vehicle margin rose to 15.3% from 9.4% in the second quarter and gross margin to 16.7%, while free cash flow turned positive at about RMB2 billion. Li Auto guided fourth-quarter deliveries of 110,000–115,000 vehicles and revenue of RMB31.7–33.1 billion.

The shares had fallen sharply over the past year as competition in China’s electric-car market squeezed prices and the company posted three losses in a row. With expectations that low, evidence that margins have bottomed and a stated path back to profit was enough to lift the stock, even though some reports said the fourth-quarter outlook was below market estimates.

src.title: CnEVPost: Li Auto expects Q4 return to profit
